counterBadgeChars.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply. {count} is the formatted number of characters (line breaks excluded); keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeWords.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply. {count} is the formatted number of words (each Chinese, Japanese or Korean character counts as one word); keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeCjkChars.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply. {count} is the formatted number of Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters only; keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeLines.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply. {count} is the formatted number of lines; keep {count} exactly as written
